authority: AGENT executor interpretation; proposed dispositions, not owner-originated settled decisions

findings.finding: Exchanger geometry and hydraulic/MHD qualification remain missing despite explicit area-to-UA and purchased-cost paths.
findings.disposition: Retain conditional scope; no scientific feasibility claim.

findings.finding: Brayton flow and three independent compression ratios lack qualified machine maps and priced flow/pressure capability.
findings.disposition: Keep declined axes fixed; do not infer capability from MW screens.

findings.finding: Density changes imposed fusion/fuel/heat demand with installed hardware fixed; confinement and control remain unqualified.
findings.disposition: Carry separately as demand diagnostics in follow-up comparisons.

findings.finding: Fixed 100 kg/calendar-year feed clips external purchases to zero at the lower-density point; density ranking differs between supply scenarios.
findings.disposition: Preserve fixed feed/service pairs and report gross makeup, purchases and contributions.

findings.finding: Breeding and supplied-feed qualification flags remain unsupported for every candidate in both scenarios.
findings.disposition: No supply, service or efficiency optimization; preserve assumed-supply label.

findings.finding: All three inherited source controls fail heat removal; literal Raffray also fails integrated balance in both supply scenarios.
findings.disposition: Retain all adverse controls and finite prices without ranking them as acceptable designs.

findings.finding: Local area changes leave net electricity and gross fuel demand flat while changing capital/LCOE; undersized controls fail heat removal.
findings.disposition: Carry local purchased-cost finding into coupled study; claim no minimum-area boundary or optimum.
